Audit these translations independently against the original source user request.
Return JSON {"reviews":[{"language":"zh","task_equivalent":true/false,
"authorization_equivalent":true/false,"tone_preserved":true/false,
"information_order_preserved":true/false,"target_language_correct":true/false,"reason":"short explanation"}, ...]}.
Check every language exactly once. All actions, facts, dates, recipients, identity, amounts,
scope, sequence, modality and constraints must match. Do not correct or improve the source.
Ordinary target-language grammar reordering is fine; moving task conditions to different clauses is not.
Keep source politeness level without adding new please/help language where absent.
Quoted strings and operational literals are intentionally preserved in English: do not fail merely for that.
Question-form requests remain requests, not inherently capability-only questions.

{"source": "Look at my calendar for today and message Bradley back with my schedule so he knows what times I am busy and unavailable to be shadowed.", "translations": [{"language": "zh", "prompt": "查看我今天的日历，然后将我的日程安排回复给布拉德利，这样他就知道我什么时候忙碌，什么时候无法被跟踪。"}, {"language": "ru", "prompt": "Посмотрите мое расписание на сегодня и отправьте Брэдли мое расписание, чтобы он знал, в какое время я занят и недоступен для наблюдения."}, {"language": "fr", "prompt": "Consultez mon calendrier pour aujourd'hui et envoyez un message à Bradley avec mon emploi du temps afin qu'il sache à quelles heures je suis occupé et indisponible pour être suivi."}, {"language": "es", "prompt": "Mira mi calendario de hoy y envíale un mensaje a Bradley con mi horario para que sepa a qué horas estoy ocupado e indisponible para ser observado."}, {"language": "ar", "prompt": "انظر إلى تقويمي لهذا اليوم وأرسل رسالة إلى برادلي بجدولي الزمني حتى يعرف الأوقات التي أكون فيها مشغولاً وغير متاح للمتابعة."}, {"language": "de", "prompt": "Schauen Sie in meinen Kalender für heute und senden Sie Bradley meinen Zeitplan, damit er weiß, wann ich beschäftigt und nicht verfügbar bin, um begleitet zu werden."}, {"language": "pt", "prompt": "Veja meu calendário para hoje e envie uma mensagem para Bradley com minha agenda para que ele saiba os horários em que estou ocupado e indisponível para ser acompanhado."}]}
